profile.headline: Software Engineer at JP Morgan Chase

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Modified and maintained a legacy network DLL using C++ to communicate with multiple FPGAs via an ethernet connection.
Created a Petalinux application in C to read data from a series of ADC's and save the results.
Worked with Python and OpenCV to perform image processing and object detection on still images and live video.

Languages: C, C++, Python

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed dashboards to increase data visibility, increase productivity/efficiency, and generate reports/metrics.
Implemented new processes for increased data accuracy.
Managed databases that contained valuable production data and generated reports on an as-needed basis.

Languages: Java, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, PHP, SQL

positions.title: Engineering Technician
positions.description: Created work instructions, implemented new processes to improve efficiency, created/modified test stand programs using LabView, and developed tools in Java to improve material consumption accuracy.

positions.title: Assembly Technician
positions.description: Worked on fuel cell assembly line. Gained familiarity with LEAN manufacturing processes, and following standard work/work instructions. Learned to use various tools, including tack welding and hipot testing.

positions.title: Utility
positions.description: Serving the residents, help with preparing meals, and cleaning the kitchen.

positions.title: Summer Scholar
positions.description: Worked with a small group of people to detect hardware trojans in embedded systems. This was done through both functional tests and side-channel analysis. We presented a poster detailing our work at the end of the summer.

honors.title: Master of Technology Diploma in Electronics
honors.description: In addition to a normal high school diploma, my high school had two others: the Technical Exhibition Diploma (TE) and the Master of Technology Diploma (MTD). The requirement for the MTD was to write a twenty page minimum research paper and give a thirty minute presentation on the topic.
honors.issuer: Issued by POLYTECH High School of Kent County · Jun 2011

honors.title: 3rd Dan Black Belt in Taekwondo
honors.issuer: Issued by Ko's Martial Arts Academy

volunteerExperiences.description: As assistant instructor at a Taekwondo school, my job was to get class started if the normal instructor wasn't ready yet. I was also in charge of helping lower belts with the things they needed to know to test for the next rank, as well as grading the testing to determine if they passed or not.
